name: Mukuro ~Mesu o Nerau Agito~
source:
When I woke up, I did not have a memory.

Who am I? Why am I here?

People around me do not have recollections about me as well.

I shall make my way with women using this position that I do not know anything.

And then I shall make my memory return... remember with my body!

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/09/vn-of-month-february-1998.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
醒来时，我失去了记忆。

我是谁？为什么会在这里？

周围的人同样不记得我。

我要利用这个连自己都不了解的处境，与女性们一同走出自己的道路。

然后，我会找回记忆…用身体回想起来！

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/09/vn-of-month-february-1998.html]vndbreview[/url]]
